notes.title: Minor Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
I just pushed out a cheeky little update. Nothing that exciting though, just some changes to help with matchmaking in public matches.  There's not enough concurrent players at the moment for it to make a difference, but if we do steam sales and things we might get a sudden influx and this should help people find each other.

I also didn't test it a whole lot so... fingers crossed!
